Sandbox_MinidoracatServerPatchFor42_Slim: Lighter chunk loading: Arcadia propane depots

Only runs Arcadia Refillable Propane Tanks' depot setup on tiles that can be a depot, instead of checking every tile of every loaded area. Same depots, same behavior. Takes effect after a server restart. Does nothing if that mod is not installed.
Lighter chunk loading: KI5 fixed vehicle spawns

Only checks the fixed vehicle spawn spots of KI5 vehicles (damnlib) at those spots, instead of on every tile of every loaded area. Same vehicles, same places. Takes effect after a server restart. Does nothing if damnlib is not installed.
Lighter chunk loading: semi truck fixed spawns

Only checks the guaranteed semi truck and trailer spawn spots at those spots, instead of on every tile of every loaded area. Same vehicles, same places. Takes effect after a server restart. Does nothing if the semi truck mod is not installed.
Lighter periodic scan: semi truck car trailer check

After a restart the semi truck mod re-checks every loaded vehicle each in-game minute until it finds a car trailer. This makes it check at most once every 75 real-time seconds instead, even while everyone sleeps and time fast-forwards. Car trailers loaded later get their covers restored at the next check. Takes effect after a server restart. Does nothing if the semi truck mod is not installed.
Lighter chunk loading: Vanilla Foods Expanded

Vanilla Foods Expanded's server checks for food aging, safehouse loot and lit birthday candles only run on tiles that have containers or items on the ground, and its safehouse check no longer rescans every waiting building for each of the 64 chunks of an area that loads at once. Same items, same aging, same loot. Takes effect after a server restart. Does nothing if that mod is not installed.
